name: omcron
author: Ernesto Ruy Sanchez
description: Scheduled jobs that run unattended or ask permission first.

barWidget.description: omcron jobs, their next run times, and any approval waiting on you.

schema.label: Show when idle
schema.description: Keep the widget on the bar, dimmed, when there are no scheduled jobs.

schema.label: Only when waiting
schema.description: Hide the widget unless a job is waiting for your approval. Overrides 'Show when idle'.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read job state. Changes made by the omcron command refresh the bar immediately regardless.
